summary.text: Jade Wind Dagger is an immortal killer move used in a dream realm. Jade green wind gathers into a small dagger in the palm, then shoots out like an arrow.

claims.text: In a realistic dream realm, Fang Yuan faces a young Gu Immortal with rank seven aura. After other exchanges, that Gu Immortal uses an immortal killer move: jade green wind gathers into a small dagger in his palm. The dagger shines with jade light, and Fang Yuan feels fearful of it. The Gu Immortal blows at his hand with his lips, and the jade wind dagger shoots out like an arrow, fast and ruthless, flying toward Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan does not know whether unravel dream will raise an effective immortal killer move against this jade wind dagger. Under unravel dream he activates ghost summoning instead. A Gu Immortal soul with rank seven battle strength flies toward the jade wind dagger. The young Gu Immortal fears harming that soul and cannot fight properly, and Fang Yuan kills him and passes the dream realm.
